'''Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon''',<ref name="CharEnc" /> also known by the stage name of '''Rappertunie''',<ref name="CharEnc" /> was a [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubb]] musician from [[Manpha/Legends|Manpha]] and member of the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]]. He was able to spit paralyzing poison at individuals when threatened.<ref name="CharEnc" /> This poison was able to paralyze a Human for a quarter of an hour.<ref name="DB" />

==Biography==
Rappertunie had an urge to travel ever since the day he hatched. He wasn't content with processing swamp [[petroleum]] in his marsh village and left at a young age. As he traveled extensively through the marsh communities on his continent, he funded his trips by playing musical instruments and bringing news to isolated villages. By the time he reached adulthood, he had saved enough money to take a [[Shuttle/Legends|planetary shuttle]] to [[Shanpan]], Manpha's sole [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] community.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>

An entire [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] opened up for Rappertunie as he sat in [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] and [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] conversing with [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]]. He played with many bands in Shanpan and adopted a stage name that was both easier to pronounce for aliens<ref name="SWTSE" /> and more "musician-like"<ref name="WW3">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref>– "Rappertunie". He learned how to play many new instruments, but preferred to embrace the [[Growdi Harmonique/Legends|Growdi Harmonique]]<ref name="CharEnc" /> (a combination of a [[Flute/Legends|flute]] and [[Water organ/Legends|water organ]]).<ref name="DB" />

Rappertunie had spent several years searching for a way to find passage off Manpha to see the wider galaxy. When the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] stopped at Manpha, Rappertunie disguised himself as a waiter to gain access to [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo's]] hotel suite. He displayed his musical talents to Max while the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] gorged himself on his third lunch.<ref name="WW3" /> Impressed with his skill, Max invited Rappertunie to join his band for a season in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Rappertunie eagerly accepted and became a member of the Max Rebo Band.<ref name="SWTSE" />

His enthusiasm was quickly crushed by the second stop– [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. What was supposed to be a limited engagement in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] spiraled into a permanent stay when [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] requested the band's indefinite stay in his court. Rappertunie found Tatooine's dry heat to be oppressive to his marsh dwelling form. After he exhausted all the tourist attractions on the planet, he began to look for a way off planet. His lack of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and Max's unwillingness to break his contract to Jabba meant Rappertunie was stuck in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].<ref name="SWTSE" /> 

While in Jabba's court, Rappertunie had to drink a great deal of [[Water/Legends|water]] to keep from getting dehydrated. He remained quietly perched on his growdi to avoid unnecessary exertion, even when he wasn't performing before Jabba with the rest of the Max Rebo Band. While this made him appear like easy prey for the predators in Jabba's court, Rappertunie was able to defend himself with his paralytic spit. Having no interest in bloodsports, he declined to accompany the group assembled to execute [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Fortunately for him, this was his salvation, as Jabba Desilijic Tiure died in the explosion of [[Khetanna/Legends|his sail barge]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="SWTSE" />

Rappertunie had been petitioning [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] to get a gig on another planet for months, but now he finally had his means of escape.<ref name="SWTSE" /> Once news of Jabba's death reached the palace, he left for Mos Eisley. He was relieved to see his band mates had survived continued his music career for a short while after departing with Max Rebo and Sy Snootles. When Sy Snootles' career began to falter after she left Max to pursue a solo career, Rappertunie left her and the music scene altogether. He settled down to be a computer engineer for [[Rebaxan Columni/Legends|Rebaxan Columni]], designing upgrades for their [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6]] droid line.<ref name="WW3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rappertunie was added to the extended musical number in the Special Edition of ''Return of the Jedi''. He was played using a traditional puppet digitally inserted into the film.

Rappertunie's backstory has similarities with that of Muppet character [[W:c:muppet:Kermit the Frog|Kermit the Frog]]. Both start their music careers playing an instrument in a swamp, which leads to them going on to bigger and better things and eventually achieving stardom. It is uncertain whether or not this was intentional.
